description: This file defines an interface for reading loan collateral management data within the Fineract platform, including methods for retrieving collateral details associated with loans.

classes.name: LoanCollateralManagementReadPlatformService
classes.description: Interface providing methods to access loan collateral data such as retrieving colaterals by loan ID and fetching collateral responses.

methods.name: getLoanCollaterals
methods.description: Retrieves a list of loan collateral management entities associated with a specific loan ID.

methods.name: getLoanCollateralResponseData
methods.description: Fetches collateral response data given a collateral ID.

methods.name: getLoanCollateralResponseDataList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of collateral response data objects associated with a specific loan ID.
